en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the entrance gate of an elegant 19th‑century building. In the foreground is an iron fence with a central double gate, flanked by tall stone pillars topped with ornate gas-style street lamps. Behind the gate stands a small portico with several rounded arches and balustrades, partly obscured by large trees and foliage. The image is framed with a cream border and rounded photo corners, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
